name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TraceLock.check_shape
title: Certified exact width-independent gate count, depth and meaning for the trace predicate
statement: For any registered-length gate stream, the compiled two-input AND/XOR expression has depth 15 and 12288 gate occurrences. Its output is true exactly if the first 4096 trace bits are the honest estep trace and the final trace bit is true.
